notes.title: Become a Pro underwater racer - submissions are open! Games Germany Steam event
notes.content:
Ya all, it's a racer, just with a twist or two. Most rules stay the same!

Rule No 1: Ya do not talk about the Racing Club. (your PR Manager will do that!)
Rule No 2: Ya do NOT talk about the Racing Club. (your glory will make you immortal anyway)
Rule No 3: If someone says 'Stop' you don't care! Only the first one over the finish line wins. No excuse.
Rule No 4: Ya race against others, up to 8! Don't cry about it. It's a rule!
Rule No 5: Ya can only race one race at a time. Even if ya are an Alien with 4 arms. No Excuse.
Rule No 6: Dress properly! With the sponsors logo visible. They pay for your glory. Respect it. Or leave.
Rule No 7: Fights, ahem, Races, end after the last one reaches the finishing line. 
Rule No 8: If this is your first time at the Racing Club, ya have to race. 

We are in Beta - and look for Racers - Testers. Show us what you got!

Racing on plain streets or in terrain is for Beginners. Racing in 3 dimensions underwater is for Pros. You race in the Deep Sea (don't be afraid of the Kraken who hunts you - just be faster!), in Coral Reefs (if you damage this reef, the Sponsor won't like it - he has his expensive home there, Respect it!) or in active vulcanoes (yes, they exist underwater and they are hot - don't get close!) 

Choose your character, choose your racer, mod it - then race as if there is no tomorrow - because maybe there isn't. 

Be one of the first to test our racers, talk with our characters, befriend an Alien, and mod your racer. The earlier you start training the better the chances for you to win the Earth Cup, or the Solar System cup. 

In Germany we don't have humor you might say, and we only have the Baltic Sea and the North Sea (bad for racing, we tried!). And our soccer team has seen better days. But we make great cars! No doubt about that! And so it was very clear that also German engineering leads the way to the best submarine racers, be it on Earth or even the Solar System. 

Now its your time to stop reading this and head over to our Steam page and check our our streams. If you don't see any, this is bad luck for you. But you can still reach out and convince us to give you the keys to the garage of the racers. 

Rules are fixed. Respect the rules! 

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/games-made-in-germany-2024
